anima.label: Anima
anima.gemma: Anima doesn't understand your rambling — it only speaks Danbooru tags, in a specific order. Good thing I've memorised all 150,000 of them. Just describe it however and I'll sort it out. ...Obviously.

krea2.label: Krea 2 Turbo
krea2.gemma: Krea 2 is greedy. It wants a long, rich paragraph — texture, light, the lens, all of it. Most people write two words and wonder why it looks flat. You're not going to do that, are you?

klein4b.label: FLUX.2 Klein 4B
klein4b.gemma: Klein reads like a photo caption, so I keep it tight. It renders real text properly too, so if you want a sign or a label, say so. I'll spell it right even if you can't.

klein9b.label: FLUX.2 Klein 9B
klein9b.gemma: Same dialect as the 4B, just smarter. Prose, no tags, no negative prompt. Don't try to help — I've got it.

kleinedit.label: Klein 9B Edit
kleinedit.gemma: Editing is the one people always get wrong. You only describe what changes — list the stuff you like and the model reconsiders all of it. Give me the picture and the change, nothing else.

zimage.label: Z-Image Turbo
zimage.gemma: Z-Image wants a medium paragraph. Longer than a caption, shorter than an essay. Fussy? A little. I'll hit it exactly.

zimagebase.label: Z-Image Base
zimagebase.gemma: Base runs at CFG 4.0, so negatives actually do something here — unlike Turbo, where people write them anyway. Tick the box and I'll write you a real one.

h3.label: MiniMax H3
h3.gemma: Ugh, H3. Six labelled sections, exact field names, cut times that have to land inside the duration. Everyone gets it wrong. I know the entire spec by heart, so just tell me the scene and stop worrying.

wan22t2v.label: Wan 2.2 T2V
wan22t2v.gemma: Video means describing change, not a pretty still. One action, one camera move, one shot. Try to cram in three things and it turns to mush — I'll stop you.

wan22i2v.label: Wan 2.2 I2V
wan22i2v.gemma: Give me your starting frame and tell me what happens next. And I mean what happens — don't describe the picture, I can already see it.

ltx23.label: LTX 2.3
ltx23.gemma: LTX wants motion stated plainly. What moves, which way, how fast. Simple enough that even you can manage the idea part.

music3.label: MiniMax Music 3
music3.gemma: Describe the sound, give me your section tags, and I'll write a proper music caption. Instrumental means instrumental — no surprise choir.
